instruction: Rename the column header 'Order ID' to just 'ID' in the spreadsheet.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to reorder columns in LibreOffice Calc by selecting, deleting, and re-inserting columns. It selected column D (Last Name), deleted it, but failed to properly paste it back. The model spent 50 turns struggling with cut/paste column operations and ended up with data loss.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select cells and columns in LibreOffice Calc, navigate to specific cells, use right-click context menus, and access keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+S
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed at multi-column reordering. It deleted the Last Name column but could not successfully move columns to new positions. The cut-insert column workflow was too complex for the model.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single cell edit (renaming a header) which is well within the model's demonstrated ability to navigate to cells and type values
metadata.explanation: Task requires editing cell C1 from 'Order ID' to 'ID'. Evaluator reads cell C1 and checks if it equals 'ID'.

Expected value 'ID' matches the instruction requirement to rename 'Order ID' to 'ID'
